name: Rushikulya (RHR)
description: Boys' freshers' hall, one of the newest. Night canteen known for chai and pakoras.

name: Sangam
description: Girls' freshers' hall; not single-occupancy.

name: Mahanadi (MHR)
description: Boys' hostel (2nd year onwards). Older hostel; night canteen known for biryani and side dishes.

name: Brahmaputra (BHR)
description: Boys' hostel (2nd year onwards). Night canteen serves aloo/paneer parathas and rolls. Amul parlour nearby.

name: Ganga
description: Girls' hostel (2nd year onwards). Single occupancy.

name: Subarnarekha (SHR)
description: Girls' hostel. The only hall with no night canteen. Single occupancy.

name: School of Electrical and Computer Sciences (SECS)
description: Houses CSE, ECE and EE; VLSI and semiconductor labs; mini library and Shuchi canteen behind it.

name: School of Basic Sciences (SBS)
description: Teaches first-year Maths, Chemistry and Physics. Near Lab Complex, Nescafe and Raju canteen.

name: School of Mechanical Sciences (SMS)
description: Mechanical Engineering school; houses the Design and Innovation Centre (DIC) on the 3rd floor.

name: School of Infrastructure (SOI)
description: Civil Engineering school; some EDG sessions held here.

name: School of Earth, Ocean and Climate Sciences
description: Runs ESTM course; mainly for Masters and PhD students.

name: School of Minerals, Metallurgical and Materials Engineering
description: New building near RHL; short distance between classes and labs.

name: School of Humanities, Social Sciences and Management (SHSSM)
description: Breadth courses and B.Sc-B.Ed Economics; many courses held in LHL.

name: Laboratory Complex (LBC)
description: Contains most first-year labs except Introduction to Manufacturing Processes.

name: Lecture Hall Complex (LHC)
description: Large lecture halls across LHL/UHL/RHL; most first-year classes are in UHL.

name: Central Library
description: Central library serving the institute with book circulation; reading room on 5th floor.

name: Reading Room
description: Quiet reading room; extended hours during exams (up to 24/7 sometimes).

name: SECS Library
description: A small departmental library inside SECS.

name: Design and Innovation Centre (DIC)
description: Funds projects, provides tools and materials; mentoring available.

name: Student Activity Centre (SAC)
description: Indoor sports facilities including badminton courts and table tennis; Rolling Crunchy's eatery is here.

name: Football Ground
description: Outdoor football ground with coaching; coach: Mr. Biswajit Pegu.

name: Cricket Ground
description: Cricket ground at permanent campus in Arugul with practice net.

name: Basketball Courts
description: Multiple courts available; five new courts recently built.

name: Tennis Courts
description: Under development.

name: Athletics Field
description: Tracks and areas for javelin, hammer, long jump and sprints.

name: Gym
description: Weight training and modern machines available.

name: Swimming Pool
description: Newly inaugurated pool used for multiple strokes and water polo.

name: Sanjeevan Health Centre
description: On-campus health centre with Apollo medical store nearby.

name: Club House (Aanand)
description: Residents' club venue for activities and kids' programs.

name: Parampara
description: Venue for classical and traditional arts; located in front of the Director's bungalow.

name: Community Centre
description: Used for decorations and campus events (e.g., Diwali).

name: Main Gate
description: Pickup point for DriEV rental and visitor entry.

name: Radhika Store
description: General store for daily needs and party supplies.

name: Kanhaz Restaurant
description: In-campus restaurant offering inexpensive meals (chole bhature, snacks).

name: General Store (Old Shopping Complex)
description: General shop with varied items; restocked frequently.

name: Stationery Store
description: Supplies art materials, chargers, earphones, umbrellas and caps.

name: Omfed Parlour
description: Ice cream and drinks; try the mango lassi and cookies & cream.

name: Fruit Stall
description: Fresh fruit bowls and juices.

name: Amul (BHR)
description: Ice cream parlour located near BHR hostel.

name: Rolling Crunchy's
description: Fast food: pizzas, burgers, rolls and fried rice.

name: Raju's Canteen
description: Snacks and meals on lab-report days.

name: Nescafe
description: Coffee, Maggi and sandwiches.

name: Shuchi
description: Sells milk cakes, sandwiches and momos.

name: SIF Canteen
description: New canteen; user reviews requested.

name: Night Canteens
description: One in every hostel except SHR; open from 18:00.

name: Mio Amore
description: Bakery near LHL; check expiry dates on perishables.

name: Mother's Touch
description: Homemade food cooked by faculty families.

name: Jai Shree Ram
description: Serves bajjis, pakodas, drinks and packaged food.

name: Domino's
description: Offers a Lunch meal (five courses) noted for value.

name: Ama Bus Route 38
description: Route: Bhubaneswar Railway Station ⇄ Taraboi via Khordha Bypass and IIT; schedule emailed.

name: Institute Buses
description: Covers classes and labs; often crowded. Schedule emailed.

name: Cycles
description: Useful for travelling across campus at your own pace.

name: E-rickshaws
description: Last-mile transport; contacts: +91 76839 95772; +91 89173 27084.

name: DriEV (EV rental)
description: EV rental app pickup near main gate; bookings 10:00-19:00; driving licence required.

name: Auto-rickshaws
description: Use in emergencies only.
